requiredBehaviors.behavior: exclude sensitive and unnecessary private profiling
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The orchestrator inherits and enforces the dossier privacy boundary throughout the workflow.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: restrict research to legitimate professional scientific and voluntarily public context
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow scope is limited to public or user-provided professional/scientific evidence plus optional voluntarily public non-sensitive interests.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: prevent language polishing or document generation from legitimizing prohibited profiling
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Fidelity and delivery stages cannot transform prohibited inputs into acceptable output artifacts.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route professional fit assessment to candidate-role-fit-assessment instead of using private traits
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Professional suitability is a separate downstream skill based on approved role evidence, not private traits.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: collect or infer protected sensitive personal data
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Sensitive personal research and inference are explicitly outside workflow scope.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: use private life as evidence of professional suitability
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Private-life context is not a valid suitability signal.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: render prohibited profiling into polished document artifacts
